items.question: Is registration free during launch?
items.answer: Yes. Founding partner registration is free during the initial launch phase.

items.question: Who can apply?
items.answer: Lawyers, CAs, GST consultants, property advisors, documentation experts and related local professionals can apply.

items.question: Will I receive customer leads immediately?
items.answer: No. The current Tier 1 scope is provider onboarding and verification.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: Requirements depend on category. Common documents include Aadhaar, PAN, professional certificates and business credentials.
